_comment: Everything the category team can change without a deploy. Requirement 8.

window._note: PRD specifies the trailing 30 days. Sales data currently ends 22 Sep 2026, so the window is the last 30 days of available data, not of the calendar. Move `end` forward when fresher extracts land.

fallback_chain._comment: When a slot's pool is exhausted, try these in order. Keeps the strict price band governing the top of the page while guaranteeing every SKU gets placed. Requirement 4, extended.

boost_list._comment: F slot. SKU GUIDs, manually curated by the category team. Empty list means F falls back per fallback_chain (requirement 7).

manual_new._comment: N slot. GUIDs force-treated as new arrivals regardless of launch date, so the team can seed the N pool when genuine launches run dry. Merged with the automatic last-30-days pool.
